title: TNBC chromatin-informed regulatory framework transfer pilot

anchor.title: A chromatin-informed transcriptional regulatory framework to stratify patients and guide therapy selection in triple-negative breast cancer

goal.success_definition: A reviewed pilot outcome with traceable direction, data, code, minimal real execution and recorded workflow feedback

constraints.compute: All real data processing and analysis must run on the project cloud server under /media/desk16/iy13202/projects/Paper2Paper; the local checkout is limited to source materials, Git-tracked specifications, code, compact results and reports.

stop_rule: Figures 1-5 and their planned supplementary figures are complete under the user-approved TNBC-anchor-aligned protocol. Do not claim a broad three-system motif program: 31 chromatin-prioritized HC-TFs were identified, but only FOXA3, NFATC4 and XBP1 met the strict three-system motif rule. Prognostic evidence is exploratory and does not reproduce as a robust cross-cohort framework. Five drug-TF associations replicated across at least two cell-line screens, but none passed the prespecified PDX validation rule; therefore no therapy-selection claim is supported. Further work requires a newly preregistered validation or redesigned biological question, not post hoc threshold relaxation.
